en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5544 - Yunus ibn Abd Al-Rahman narrated from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a man who died and left behind a slave. One of his children testified that their father had freed the slave.
Imam (as) said: "His testimony is accepted, and he is not held financially responsible. However, the slave must work to compensate the share that belonged to the other heirs."
